senses.gloss: m. (בטי) vain, useless talk, ref. to vows and oaths which neither benefit nor injure anybody; שבועת ב׳ a useless oath, contrad. to ש׳ שוא a false oath or one asserting something impossible.
units: <cite ref="Shevuot 49b:9">Ib. 49ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Bava Metzia 36a:2">B. Mets. 36ᵃ</cite> an oath imposed in court <he>אין בה משום שבועת ב׳</he> does not come under the law of vain oaths (as to sacrifices).

<cite ref="Bava Metzia 36a:2">Ib.</cite> <he>ב׳ שפתים</he> erroneous statement without legal consequences, oppos. to <he>כפירת ממון</he> whereby somebody lost money. [Y. Naz. I, beg. 51ᵃ <he>שביטוי שבועה</he>, read <he>שכִּינּוּיֵי</he>.]
